dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 3B-Provincial Transitway alignments for planned bus rapid transit express bus service.  The Provincial Transitway is a higher-order regional transit corridor planned and operated within the broader provincial transportation network. It is intended to improve the movement of people across municipalities, support sustainable travel choices, and facilitate transit-supportive growth along its route.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
